title: Cross-Document Question Answering — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Answers questions using evidence from multiple uploaded documents. The Cross-Document Question Answering tool answers questions using multiple uploaded documents. It searches across all the student's papers, notes, and readings at once, pulls the relevant passages from each, and synthesizes an answer with every claim cited to its document and page. When documents disagree, it shows the disagreement instead of hiding it.
capabilities: Search across many documents at once
Cite document and page per claim
